Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: Ilwww.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 131 s. 2022 October 17, 2022 THE SANGGUNIANG BAYAN OF CALATAGAN, BATANGAS Thru: VICE-MAYOR ROGELIO H. ZARRAGA Presiding Officer — Sangguniang Bayan Sbcalatagan2021@gmail.com Dear Honorable Members of the Sangguniang Bayan: This has reference to your e-mail dated 03 August 2022 seeking our legal opinion and/or clarification regarding the issuance of a cockfighting or "sabong" special permit. Specifically, the issue raised was quoted, viz: "xxx nais po naming malinawan kung ang pagbibigay ng permiso (Special Permit), katulad ng sa ibang bayan, sa pangasiwaan ng sabungan upang makapagdaos ng sabong (Pintakasi, Derby o Concierto) sa araw na hindi hindi (sic) kasama sa regular na araw ng pagsasabong ay naayon sa ating batas at saklaw ng kapangyarihan ng Sanggunian". Please be informed that the aforesaid issue has already been settled by the Department in DILG Legal Opinion No. 60, series of 2019, pertinent portion of which reads: "xxx What is expressed in Republic Act No. 7160 (RA 7160), otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, is that the Sangguniang Bayan may authorize and license the establishment, operation, and maintenance of cockpits, and regulate cockfighting and commercial breeding of gamecocks. It is not expressed therein whether the Sangguniang Bayan may issue a special permit for the conduct of cockfight in a cockpit that has yet to secure a license or franchise to operate. Nonetheless, the answer can be gleaned from Presidential Decree No. 449 (PD 449), otherwise known as the Cockfighting Law of 1974. Section 5(d) and (e) of PD 449 finds application. It states: Section 5. Cockpits and Cockfighting: In General: xxxx (d) Holding of Cockfights. Except as provided in this Decree, cockfighting shall be allowed only in licensed cockpits durinq Sundays and leqal holidays and durinq local fiestas for not more than three days. It mav also be held durinq provincial. city or municipal, aqricultural, commercial or industrial fair. carnival or exposition for a similar Deriod of three days upon resolution of the "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

province, city or municipality where such fair, carnival or exposition is to be held, subiect to the approval of the Chief of Constabulary or his authorized representative: Provided, that, no cockfighting on the occasion of such fair, carnival or exposition shall be allowed within the month of a local fiesta or for more than two occasions a year in the same city or municipality: Provided, further, that no cockfighting shall be held on December 30 (Rizal Day), June 12 (Philippine Independence Day) November 30 (National Heroes Day), Holy Thursday, Good Friday, Election or Referendum Day and during Registration Days for such election or referendum. (e) Cockfighting for Entertainment of Tourists or for Charitable Purposes. Subject to the preceding subsection hereof, the Chief Constabulary or his authorized representative may. also allow the holdinq of cockfiqhtinq for the entertainment of foreiqn di nitaries or for tourists or for returnin Fili inos commonl known as "Balikbavan". or for the support of national fund- raisinq campaigns for charitable purposes as mav be authorized bv the Office of the President. upon resolution of a provincial board. city or municipal council. in licensed cockpits or in playgrounds or parks: Provided, that this privilege shall be extended for only one time, fora period not exceeding three days, within a year to a province, city, or municipality. With the passage of RA 7160, the authority to license the establishment and operation of cockfighting has been expressly granted to the Sanggunian. But even so, we are one with the pronouncement of the Supreme Court, in the case of Tan vs. Perea, that while RA 7160 now governs as to the authority of the Sangguniang Bayan to authorize or license establishment, operation, and maintenance of cockpits, it is still subject to the limitations laid down in PD 449. The Court even said that 'there is no dichotomy between affirming the power and subjecting it to limitations at the same time.' Thus, we opine that the Sanggunian is authorized by law to issue a license or permit for the conduct of cockfight but only when the same shall be conducted in a licensed cockpit or gallera. On the aspect of whether or not the Sangguniang bayan has the authority to approve the special permit granted by the Mayor for the conduct of cockfighting, we opine in the negative. RA 7160 places upon the Sangguniang Bayan, and not upon the Mayor, the authority to issue license for the operation of cockfight." A copy of the aforesaid DILG Legal Opinion is hereto attached for ease of reference. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. Page 2 of 3

We hope to have provided sufficient guidance on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: CTOR R.
